Cache hit with OpenDAL memory backend returns cached response on repeat request

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest::from_json(json_encode(["messages" => [["content" => "Hello", "role" => "user"]], "model" => "openai/gpt-4o"]));
$client = LiterLlm::createClientFromJson('{"api_key":"your-api-key","cache":{"backend":"opendal:memory","max_entries":256,"ttl_seconds":300}}');
$result = $client->chat($req);
var_dump($result);
```
